title: Armchair with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x='20' y='15' width='60' height='50' rx='14' fill='#e8734a'/>
  <rect x='26' y='21' width='48' height='38' rx='10' fill='#ff8f5e'/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x='18' y='55' width='64' height='22' rx='9' fill='#ff7a45'/>
  <rect x='23' y='58' width='54' height='14' rx='6' fill='#ffa06e'/>
  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x='8' y='42' width='16' height='36' rx='8' fill='#d95f36'/>
  <rect x='11' y='46' width='10' height='26' rx='5' fill='#f07a4c'/>
  <!-- right armrest -->
  <rect x='76' y='42' width='16' height='36' rx='8' fill='#d95f36'/>
  <rect x='79' y='46' width='10' height='26' rx='5' fill='#f07a4c'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='24' y='77' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8a4b2a'/>
  <rect x='67' y='77' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8a4b2a'/>
  <!-- smiley face on backrest -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3b2a1e'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3b2a1e'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffd9c2'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffd9c2'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- big smile -->
  <path d='M36 46 Q50 60 64 46' stroke='#3b2a1e' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M44 51 Q50 58 56 51' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
</svg>
